description: Redesign ZonePropertiesPanel.tsx for professional CAD/CPQ-style clarity with organized sections (Identity, Dimensions, Constraints, SKU Assignment, Actions), consistent design tokens, inline validation, and improved UX while preserving all existing data-testid attributes and business logic
steps: Refactor frontend/src/components/ZonePropertiesPanel.tsx inline styles to use CSS custom properties from design-system.css. Replace hard-coded colors (#e0e0e0, #e3f2fd, #1565c0, #fbe9e7, #f44336, etc.) with the project's design tokens (--color-hairline, --color-error, --color-surface, --color-canvas, --color-ink-primary, --color-ink-secondary, --color-success).

Restructure the panel into clear sections with progressive disclosure: (1) Panel header 'Zone Properties'. (2) Zone Identity section - zone ID (read-only), segment badge for L-Corner walls. (3) Position section - X/Y coordinates in a compact 2-column row with 'mm' units. (4) Dimensions section - Width/Height in a compact 2-column row with 'mm' units. (5) Strategy section - Width Strategy and Height Strategy selects. (6) Validation section - inline errors near affected fields or in a compact alert at top. (7) SKU Assignment section - assigned SKU info or 'No SKU assigned' state, Assign/Remove actions. (8) Multi-selection state with clear count indicator.
Improve section headers: use consistent uppercase 12px --color-ink-secondary label style (matching WallConfigPanel's SECTION_HEADER_STYLE pattern).

Improve form controls: (a) All inputs/selects consistent 32px height with proper padding. (b) Use the same INPUT_STYLE, INPUT_READONLY_STYLE patterns as WallConfigPanel for visual consistency between the two panels. (c) Numeric inputs for position/dimensions should be compact with clear 'mm' labeling. (d) Focus states with --color-accent ring.

Improve validation errors display: (a) Use --color-error token for the error container background/border. (b) More compact error messages - no bullet list if only one error. (c) Position errors near the top of the panel but do not overwhelm the editing area. (d) Use concise actionable messages.

Improve SKU assignment section: (a) Use subtle --color-canvas background card style. (b) Clear typography hierarchy: SKU code in semibold, material/colour in regular weight below. (c) 'No SKU assigned' state with muted text and clear CTA. (d) Assign SKU button as primary action (btn-primary style). (e) Remove SKU as a subtle destructive action (--color-error text, no fill).
Improve the multi-selection state display: use the design system info color scheme and show a clear count with relevant messaging.
Improve the segment badge for L-Corner walls: use design system colors for SEGMENT_A (--color-success tints) and SEGMENT_B (accent tints) with consistent badge styling.

Preserve ALL existing data-testid attributes: zone-properties-panel, multi-select-info, zone-validation-errors, input-zone-name, segment-badge, input-zone-x, input-zone-y, input-zone-width, input-zone-height, select-width-strategy, select-height-strategy, assign-sku-btn, remove-sku-btn.
Ensure responsive behavior at 280px panel width - compact 2-col layouts for position/dimension fields should stack or shrink gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: All existing data-testid attributes are preserved with identical names
TypeScript type check passes (npm run typecheck)
No business logic changes - handleFieldChange callback with clampDimensions, constrainToWall, hasOverlap all remain unchanged
Panel uses design system tokens consistently
Section hierarchy matches the structured organization (Identity, Position, Dimensions, Strategy, Validation, SKU)
Validation errors are displayed using design system error tokens
SKU section has clear assigned/unassigned states
Visual consistency between WallConfigPanel and ZonePropertiesPanel (same input heights, label styles, spacing)
findings: All 1144 unit/component tests pass including ZonePropertiesPanel.validation.test.tsx (6 tests). Build succeeds cleanly. Pre-existing typecheck error in ValidationOverlayLayer.tsx (TS6133 unused var) unchanged. 8 e2e suites fail due to missing SUPABASE_URL env var (pre-existing). Design system tokens used consistently throughout with matching WallConfigPanel patterns.
